title: The Case of the Phantom Meeting
style: Drawn in code (scenes-poster.js): flat screen-print poster shapes, ink black, signal red, cream paper and mustard yellow, risograph grain, tiny figures under immense shapes.
voiceStyle: a weary film-noir detective narrating a case, low and unhurried
music: Tense modern film-noir score for a detective story about a con: low pulsing synth bass, muted trumpet phrases, brushed snare, plucked pizzicato strings, slow suspense that builds, minor key, sparse and cinematic, no vocals.
ambience: Quiet late-night city hum high up in an office tower, distant traffic far below, faint air conditioning, no music.

shots.say: Twenty-five million dollars. Gone after one video call. Every face on that call was fake.

sfx.prompt: Deep cinematic low boom hit with a long dark tail
Slow footsteps of leather shoes on a polished stone floor in a vast empty hall, echo

shots.say: Hong Kong, January 2024. A finance worker at the engineering firm Arup gets a message from his finance chief in London.

ov.sub: A finance worker at Arup, a British engineering firm

sfx.prompt: Rain falling on an umbrella and a city sidewalk at night, a car passing slowly on a wet street
Single clean smartphone message notification chime

shots.say: It asks for a secret transaction. He suspects phishing. His instinct is right.

ov.by: What the message asked for, per Hong Kong police

sfx.prompt: Wind on a high balcony at night, distant city hum far below
Phone screen tap and a soft swipe, quiet, close up

shots.say: Then a video call. The finance chief and colleagues, looking and sounding like people he knows.

ov.sub: The CFO and several colleagues, on screen

sfx.prompt: Video call connecting chime, modern and clean
Soft murmur of several people greeting each other at the start of an online office meeting, slightly compressed like a laptop speaker

shots.say: So he puts his doubt aside. Fifteen transfers. Two hundred million Hong Kong dollars. About twenty-five million US.

sfx.prompt: Low ominous cello drone slowly swelling, suspense
Quick keyboard typing then a series of short digital confirmation beeps, like bank transfers going through

shots.say: Later, he checks with head office. Nobody had asked. Police said everyone on that call was fake.

ov.text: “It turns out that everyone [he saw] was fake.”
ov.by: Baron Chan Shun-ching, Hong Kong police

sfx.prompt: Old office desk phone ringing twice, then the receiver picked up, quiet room
Deep heartbeat thump followed by an ominous low orchestral swell, horror reveal

shots.say: The fakes were built from public videos and audio of real executives. No system was hacked.

ov.sub: Public video and audio of real executives

sfx.prompt: Digital glitch stutters and soft data processing noises, computer generating something

shots.say: Arup's tech chief called it technology-enhanced social engineering. The target was trust.

ov.by: Rob Greig, Arup's chief information officer

sfx.prompt: Low eerie wind howling between tall skyscrapers, dark drone

shots.say: His lesson? We really do have to start questioning what we see.

ov.text: “We really do have to start questioning what we see.”

sfx.prompt: Cold wind through tall bare trees in winter, a distant crow, very quiet
Slow footsteps crunching through fresh snow

shots.say: A machine can copy a face. Only a person can stop and ask: is this really you? Case closed.

ov.sub: Call back on a number you know. Ask what only they would know. Slow down at “secret” and “urgent”.

sfx.prompt: Slow footsteps on a stone path outdoors, wind, distant bell
Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
